what: Round 1218. What a video review changes in top division football, per match, as published counts. The Club Manager review rates are DERIVED from this file by scripts/genCmVarRates.mjs. Nobody types a rate.
rules: A quantity is USED only when at least two independent publishers give a count for it. One publisher is THIN and is not used.
Where publishers count differently the engine takes the STRICTER reading: the lowest per match figure in the rows, so a review moves fewer results, never more.
The range of a quantity is its lowest and highest per match reading. scripts/simCmVar.mjs holds the engine inside that range plus headroom it measured.
A count is copied as the page prints it, with the sentence or line it was read from. Matches a season is arithmetic on the league's size (20 clubs: 380, 18 clubs: 306).

rows.literalNote: The page also gives penalties taken back and red cards after a review. Those two were read without their sentence, so they are not figures here.

goalsRuledOut.label: goals ruled out after a review, per match

penaltiesAwarded.label: penalties awarded after a review, per match

penaltiesCancelled.label: penalties cancelled after a review, per match
penaltiesCancelled.why: The engine never takes a given penalty back. Recorded so the number is on file when it does.

goalsAwarded.label: goals awarded after a review, per match
goalsAwarded.why: The engine has no goal that was first flagged off and then given.

redCards.label: red cards after a review, per match
redCards.why: The engine reviews goals and penalties only.

reviewsRejected.label: reviews after which the referee kept the call, per match
reviewsRejected.why: One publisher, and it does not say whether the call was a goal, a penalty or a card. So the game never shows a review that ends with the call standing.

awardedPenaltiesScored.label: penalties awarded after a review that were scored
awardedPenaltiesScored.why: One publisher. A penalty a review awards is taken under the engine's own penalty kick law (the base rate a shootout kick uses), not under a number of its own.

notUsed: Why a goal is ruled out (offside, handball, a foul) is split by one publisher only (the ESPN rows above). THIN: the review card names no reason.
La Liga 2024-25 (a newspaper count repeated by other sites: 189 interventions) was read on a site repeating it, with figures that do not add up between the copies. Not a row.
Totals of interventions with no split (the Dutch and the German federations' season figures, the Brazilian league's 2025 survey) say nothing about goals or penalties. Not rows.
